intervals.label: end of MINOS+ run
intervals.quote: After more than a decade of running, on June 29, the Main Injector Neutrino Oscillation Search experiment and its second iteration, MINOS+, concluded their runs.

physics_goals.quote: This was superseded by MINOS+, the continuation of the two-detector, on-axis, long-baseline experiment based at Fermilab, and at the Soudan Underground Laboratory in northern Minnesota.
physics_goals.value: Continue the MINOS oscillation programme with a medium-energy NuMI beam to search for exotic phenomena including non-standard interactions and sterile neutrinos

summary.plain: MINOS's second act: the same two detectors kept running from 2013 to 2016 on a higher-energy beam, hunting for a hypothetical fourth kind of neutrino.
summary.technical: Upgrade of MINOS (same collaboration, same near/far magnetised steel-scintillator detectors) running on the NuMI beam restarted in September 2013 after the post-MINOS accelerator shutdown, with a medium-energy configuration for sterile-neutrino and non-standard-interaction searches; concluded 29 June 2016.
